title: RHEnd GATED:  THE ENDPOINT is named -  rh_program78 (actual zeta set + [Z78],  CONCRETE wire):  S2 covered / S4 strip / S4 low / far region PROVEN IN BODY;  the named residual is EXACTLY FOUR legs:  hs1 (S1 witness),  hs3 (S3 wire),  hWin (S4 window-pin SHAPE,  gate ratio 1662.5),  hS2low (S2 low-band pin)
body: RHEnd.lean  GATED  (formal/RhAttack/RHEnd.lean,  221  lines,  sorry-free,  full  tree  build  green  17450  jobs  after  changes):  THE  ENDPOINT  OF  THE  PROGRAM,  stated  ONCE,  on  the  ACTUAL  zeta  zero  set  under  the  named  external  input  [Z78]  (Re  s  >  7/8  zero-free,  kernel-verified,  human  review  in  progress),  at  the  CONCRETE  wire,  via  S4A.rh_from_regime_closures  (the  P1.2  engine).  Wire  instantiation:  Mf  =  Z78P12.MfP  (the  residue  tail,  =  0),  devOf  =  devProg  =  S1LowT.devStripMin  (the  concrete  strip  detector),  Bwire/Mr  =  Z78P12.BwireP/MrP  (the  concrete  residue  wires),  flo  =  floProg  =  the  UNIFIED  S2  floor  floStripMin  on  the  covered  region  (1000  <=  t0,  d0  <=  1/2)  and  the  near  pin  0.9975  (p8_f_near_pin)  elsewhere.  Key  structural  observations  the  composition  made  visible:  (1)  floWin  =  min(23/1000,  1  -  25/t0)  DIES  for  t0  <  25  (floWin  <=  0),  so  floStripMin  =  min(own  mass,  max(floWin,  0))  is  EXACTLY  0  on  the  low  band  [707/50,  25]  -  a  single  concrete  floor  (floStripMin  everywhere)  CANNOT  carry  the  S4  squeeze  there  (0  <  0  fails  when  the  wires  are  0);  the  low  band  must  run  on  the  PIN  (H6  regime,  0.9975)  -  which  is  why  floProg  is  piecewise  and  why  hS2low  is  a  NAMED  leg  (devStripMin  >=  0.9975  on  0  <  t0  <  1000  is  a  data  statement  of  the  H6  pin  regime,  not  a  theorem  of  the  tree)  -  the  sliver  part  (t0  <  707/50)  is  VACUOUS  under  the  named  on-line  record  (Z78P12.sliverOffPairsEmpty);  (2)  the  covered  STRIP  band  (1/200  <=  d0  <=  1/2)  is  FULLY  CLOSED  in  the  endpoint  body:  S2  via  FUnif.s2ActualFullBand  (devStripMin  >=  floStripMin,  full  band  for  the  actual  set)  and  S4  via  FUnif.s4StripUnifiedFloor  (BwireR  +  MrR  +  MfR  <  floStripMin  -  squeeze  and  S2  floor  are  ONE  OBJECT  on  the  band),  so  the  endpoint  needs  NO  hypothesis  there;  (3)  S4  on  the  low  band  is  TRIVIAL  at  the  pin  floor  (the  residue  wires  are  0  below  1000:  0  <  0.9975);  (4)  the  far  region  (d0  >  1/2)  is  VACUOUS  from  [Z78]  alone  (offPairFarEmpty,  d0  <=  3/8  <  1/2).  WHAT  REMAINS  NAMED  (exactly  four  legs,  the  program's  residual  stated  once):  hs1  -  the  S1  zero-side  witness  (Q  >=  devProg  at  every  off-pair,  Mf  =  0;  the  E1  content  whose  uniform  face  is  S1Uniform,  data  clauses  E1ClauseV3  q  7000  /  E1Clause  q  2);  hs3  -  the  S3  definition-side  wire  (Q  <=  BwireP  +  MrP);  hWin  -  the  S4  WINDOW-PIN  residual  (1000  <=  t0,  0  <  d0  <  1/200):  the  25m/25ab  window  closure  (s4asm_window_region_S4)  is  PINNED  AT  THE  NEAR  PIN  0.9975,  while  the  unified  S2  floor  there  is  floStripMin  <=  own  mass  <=  6e-4  (mownBelowFloWinCap)  -  the  SHAPE  of  the  bound-level  residue  is  recorded  in  Part  C:  nearPinData  0.9975,  mownCapData  0.0006,  ratio  1662.5  (#eval-verified);  hS2low  -  the  S2  low-band  pin  (as  above,  H6  regime,  data-verified  territory  per  the  chart).  LEAN  LESSON  OF  THE  BUILD:  dsimp  unfolds  the  wire  defs  but  does  NOT  fold  the  decidable  ifs  on  REAL  comparisons  (classical  instances),  and  the  fold  state  varies  with  context  -  the  robust  idiom  is  try-guarded  if_neg/if_pos  rewrites  (hs4low_pin)  or  a  small  have  +  simpa  (the  covered  branches);  do  NOT  rely  on  dsimp  if-folding  for  symbolic  reals.  HONESTY:  no  RH  claim  -  the  endpoint  NAMES  the  residual  (same  residual  the  chart  carries),  and  four  of  the  squeeze  regimes  are  closed  IN  BODY  rather  than  carried  as  hypotheses.  Cards:  RHEnd  added  (88  total,  521  body  lines,  within  the  500-540  target);  _MAP.md  updated  (RHEnd  is  the  terminal  of  the  actual-set  composition;  E1Clause  and  FloorUnif  removed  from  the  orphan  list  -  both  are  imported;  reading  order  now  starts  at  RHEnd).  Meanwhile  the  s31z2  5e8G  zeta  ladder  (the  last  reachable  height)  is  in  flight  -  see  its  own  log.
